subject.title: fix(session): add fallback lock file cleanup on session write-lock release

question: After the ownership race is repaired and covered, should this external PR still require real gateway proof of snapshot-mismatch cleanup, or may source-level deterministic proof receive an explicit override?
rationale: The contributor explicitly requested a proof override, but this session-state cleanup changes mutual-exclusion behavior and the reported production race has not been demonstrated after the patch.

options.title: Require real runtime proof
options.body: Require redacted gateway logs, terminal output, or a recording showing the fallback removes the orphan lock without deleting a newly acquired lock.

options.title: Allow proof override after repair
options.body: After the P1 race is fixed and deterministic process-level regressions pass, accept an explicit maintainer proof override without a live production reproduction.

recommendation.title: Require real runtime proof
recommendation.body: Require redacted gateway logs, terminal output, or a recording showing the fallback removes the orphan lock without deleting a newly acquired lock.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows the strongest involvement in the session-lock cleanup and stale-recovery policy being changed.
